question: Which of the following is NOT the capital of the corresponding country?
solution:
__
 
• The correct answer is option "2".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• Canberra is the federal capital of Australia.
 
• It occupies part of the Australian Capital territory in south eastern Australia and is about 150 miles (240 km) southwest of Sydney.
 
• It is Australia's largest inland city and the eighth-largest city overall. 
 
• Canberra city was founded and named as Canberra in 1913.
